evals.name: food-delivery-scan
evals.prompt: We lead design at a food delivery platform. Run a horizon scan for the next ten years so we know what changes to watch.
evals.expected_output: A horizon scan organised by domain (for example STEEP), with signals of change, their sources, what each might mean for the platform, how established or emerging each is, and a way to keep scanning; claims about the present are sourced or marked as assumptions, not asserted.

evals.name: library-signals-supplied
evals.prompt: We are a public library service. Here are signals our staff collected: a nearby library lends power tools; teenagers use our study rooms as quiet gaming spaces; a council report says footfall is down but Wi-Fi sessions are up; a publisher is testing subscription-only ebooks for libraries. Do a horizon scan with these and tell us what they add up to.
evals.expected_output: The user-supplied signals clustered and interpreted, what each could indicate, possible drivers, which need more evidence, implications for the library service, and further scanning questions; no invented additional statistics presented as fact.

evals.name: fashion-resale-scan
evals.prompt: Our fashion brand is considering a resale service. Do horizon scanning on the future of clothing ownership to inform the design.
evals.expected_output: Signals of change across domains relevant to clothing ownership, each with a source or marked as an assumption, clustered into themes, with implications for the resale service design and questions for further scanning.
